app.name: Dietitian Clinic Management
app.tagline: One platform for clients, nutrition plans and appointments.

landing.title: Run your dietitian practice in one place
landing.description: Follow up on clients, build nutrition plans, schedule appointments and record payments — in Arabic and English.
landing.foundationNotice: This is a foundation build: structure, auth and i18n are in place, no feature modules have been built yet.

security.title: Password and security
security.passwordBody: Enter your current password, then choose a new one.

whoSees.title: Who sees your information
whoSees.body: You and your clinic team, and nobody else. No other client can see your record, your plan or your daily check-ins.

whatIsStored.title: What you can see
whatIsStored.body: You see what your dietitian recorded for you. Their own working notes are not shown in the app, and your weight appears only if your dietitian chooses to share it.

messages.title: Messages
messages.body: The clinic sends reminders over WhatsApp or email, depending on what it has set up. You can turn any of them off in Notifications.

rights.title: Your data
rights.body: You can ask for any detail to be corrected from your profile screen, or ask for your account to be closed at the bottom of this settings screen. A person at the clinic answers both.

plan.title: I cannot see my meal plan
plan.body: A plan appears once your dietitian publishes it. A plan still being written stays with them until it is finished.

appointments.title: I asked for an appointment and it is not confirmed
appointments.body: A request is not a booking. It reaches your dietitian, and its status stays on the appointments screen until they answer.

record.title: Something in my profile is wrong
record.body: Open your profile screen and use "Request a data update". The clinic corrects it after reviewing the request.

signIn.title: I forgot my password
signIn.body: On the "Password and security" screen, send a link to your email and set a new one.

deletion.explanation: The request reaches the clinic, and nothing is deleted now. The clinic keeps a record of your appointments and plans under its own rules, and will contact you before closing your account.
deletion.pending: Your deletion request is with the clinic.

usingThePortal.title: Using the portal
usingThePortal.body: Your portal account is issued by your clinic, and you are responsible for keeping your sign-in details safe.

guidance.title: Nutrition content
guidance.body: What your plan and profile show is your dietitian's guidance for your case, not a substitute for urgent medical advice.

communications.title: Messages
communications.body: Clinic messages arrive over WhatsApp or email, depending on what you choose in Notifications.

changes.title: Changes
